name: Italian Regency of Carnaro (1920–1920)
description: A dark red gonfalon charged with a golden ouroboros enclosing seven stars of the Great Bear and the motto 'Quis contra nos', with an Italian tricolour and other ribbons at the head.
history: Banner of the Italian Regency of Carnaro, D'Annunzio's state at Fiume (1919–1920).

features.role: ouroboros with seven stars and the motto 'Quis contra nos'
